dialog.description: Details of a linked student or guardian. Close to return to the page you were on.

unlink.title: Unlink {guardian} from {student}?
unlink.consequence: {guardian} will no longer be a guardian of {student}, and loses pickup rights and parent-portal access for {student}. You can link them again later.
unlink.primaryNotice: {guardian} is the primary contact for {student}. Choose who takes over as primary contact.
unlink.lastGuardian: {guardian} is the only guardian of {student}. Link another guardian first, then unlink {guardian}.

errors.GUARDIAN_LINK_NOT_FOUND: {guardian} is no longer linked to {student}. Refresh the page.
errors.LAST_GUARDIAN_CANNOT_BE_DELETED: {student} must keep at least one guardian.
errors.PRIMARY_GUARDIAN_REQUIRED: Choose a new primary contact for {student}.
errors.REPLACEMENT_PRIMARY_GUARDIAN_INVALID: The chosen primary contact is not linked to {student}. Refresh and choose again.

linkErrors.GUARDIAN_ALREADY_LINKED: This guardian is already linked to this student.
linkErrors.STUDENT_NOT_FOUND: This student no longer exists. Refresh the page.
linkErrors.GUARDIAN_NOT_FOUND: This guardian no longer exists. Refresh the page.
